mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_memory WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND user_id = #{user} AND agent_id = #{agent} AND id = #{id} AND expires_at > #{now} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_memory WHERE expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 500
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_memory p JOIN agent_message m ON m.enterprise_id = p.enterprise_id AND m.id = p.source_message_id SET p.source_message_id = NULL WHERE m.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND m.conversation_id = #{conversation}
